🌟 caesium-app-web | JavaScript
🎯 Primary Use Case: Compressing images offline and in-browser for privacy and efficiency.
✨ Key Features: • JPG, PNG and WebP supported • Lossy and lossless compression • Keeps images metadata • Before/after comparison • Runs entirely on your browser, no images are uploaded or processed on any external server
📖 Summary: Caesium Web Image Compressor is a privacy-focused, offline web application that allows users to compress JPG, PNG, and WebP images directly in their browser. It supports both lossy and lossless compression, preserves image metadata, and offers a before/after comparison feature, ensuring no images are uploaded or processed on external servers.
